sloka: इमौ कुशलवौ राजन्नभिषिञ्च नराधिप ।कोसलेषु कुशं वीरमुत्तरेषु तथा लवम् ।। ७.१०७.७ ॥
transliteration: imau kuśalavau rājannabhiṣiñca narādhipa ।kosaleṣu kuśaṁ vīramuttareṣu tathā lavam ।। 7.107.7 ॥

translations.english: O King, O lord of men, enthrone these two, Kusha and Lava; Kusha, the brave, in Kosala, and similarly Lava in the northern regions.
